about: The example of level 3 (docs/base.md): one folder of its own, `list`, shown in the disk mode, files and words on its page. Shift and the help key open and close its page, which lists the files of its folder; the blue knob scrolls; when the page closes it writes list.txt into the folder. It changes no place of the firmware and needs the base. tools/build_all.py builds it into out/examples/.
name: list
